description:
List funds

Every Turkish investment fund, pension fund and ETF TEFAS lists, with the latest price, size, investors, returns, fees and risk. Filter by `type`, `category`, `founder`, `codes`, a text search `q` (code or title, Turkish letters optional), `tefas` and `riskLevel`; sort by size, investors, a return period, fee, code or name. Active funds only unless `status=all`. Updated every morning from TEFAS. Use for questions about Turkish mutual funds, hedge funds, private pension (BES) funds or ETFs: finding a fund by name or company, the best performers over a period, the largest funds, or the lowest fees.

GET /v1/funds on Turkish funds (SBX-FON). Costs 1 credit per call.

category.description: A category id from /funds/categories, e.g. para-piyasasi-semsiye-fonu.

codes.description: Comma-separated fund codes (up to 100), e.g. AAL,TTE.

cursor.description: The `next_cursor` of the previous page, with the same filters.

founder.description: A company code from /funds/founders, e.g. ISP.

order.description: `desc` or `asc`; default `asc` for fee, code and name, else `desc`. Funds without the sort value come last.

q.description: Words to find at the start of words of the code or the Turkish or English title; Turkish letters optional: `altin` finds ALTIN and Altın, `tekno` TEKNOLOJİ.

tefas.description: `true`: only funds traded on the TEFAS platform; `false`: only those that are not.
